title: blast_plan import reach is zero for a changed package __init__.py (queried as pkg.__init__, matches no edge)
detail: Surfaced by brief-critic review of python-from-import-edges (2026-10-25). blast_plan._import_reach strips the file extension to build the module prefix, so a changed pkg/__init__.py is queried as "pkg.__init__" — no import edge is ever named that, so importers of the package (import pkg / from pkg import x) are never flagged at-risk. Fix: map a trailing "/__init__" to the package itself ("pkg") before blast_radius, with a test that a change to pkg/__init__.py flags an `import pkg` test.
